name: JustLaunched

sources.title: Submit your SaaS — 2-step form (Details → Plan & Pay); $9 one-time or $29 with dofollow backlink + 30-day top-of-feed + priority review; 'no free plan'

requirements: Live SaaS/software product with a working landing page, clear tagline, and description of who it's for
$9 one-time submission fee; $29 tier adds dofollow backlink, 30-day top-of-feed placement, priority review, newsletter feature
Every listing is reviewed before going live — approval required
Form fields: startup name, tagline (≤120 chars), description (50-1000 chars), website URL, category, optional logo ≤5MB, up to 5 screenshots ≤8MB each, Twitter/LinkedIn URLs, submitter name + email
preparation: Website URL and category (AI & ML, Analytics, Dev Tools, E-Commerce, Education, Finance, Health, HR, Marketing, Productivity, Sales & CRM, Security, Social, Other)
Logo (PNG/JPG/WEBP ≤5MB) and up to 5 screenshots (≤8MB each)
Twitter/X and LinkedIn URLs, contact name + email
workflow: 'Continue to choose plan' → pick $9 standard or $29 promoted, pay
Review: standard within 3 business days, promoted within ~1 day; listing publishes on approval
Optional: upgrade later to promoted without resubmitting; optional 'Featured on JustLaunched' badge embed emailed post-launch
watchFor: No free plan — payment is required in step 2 before submission completes
One-time payment, permanent listing — but confirm 'permanently' claim holds
Badge is optional, not required — no reciprocal-link gate
'Directory Blast' nav item suggests a separate paid mass-submission upsell
countsAsLive: The startup appears in the JustLaunched feed/categories with its own listing page after review approval
unknowns: Whether the $9 tier link is nofollow (dofollow is advertised as the $29 add-on)
Current listing volume vs. 'thousands of early adopters' claim
